items.markdown:
The Hebrew letter Pe (also spelled Peh, Pei, or Pey, Hebrew: **פ** ) is the 17th letter of the Hebrew alphabet and has a numerical value (Gematria) of **80** . You can explore more about its background on [Wikipedia's Pe (Semitic letter) page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pe_(Semitic_letter)) or read deep insights via [Chabad's Peh-Feh Guide](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137089/jewish/Peh-Feh.htm).[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Pey/pey.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KDDr4JBbZqw&t=127)[[3]](https://www.jewishencyclopedia.com/articles/11963-pe)[[4]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137089/jewish/Peh-Feh.htm)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pe_(Semitic_letter))

### Core Meaning and Symbolism

- **Mouth and Speech:** The name *Pe* literally means **"mouth"** in Hebrew (*peh* ). It symbolizes communication, the spoken word, and expression.
- **Placement after Ayin:** It follows *Ayin* (which means "eye"), signifying that speech should naturally follow what one sees and understands.
- **Power of Words:** Tradition views the mouth as a vessel of immense spiritual power capable of creating, blessing, or causing harm.[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Pey/pey.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137089/jewish/Peh-Feh.htm)[[3]](https://biblehub.com/topical/p/pe.htm)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/thejerusalemscribe/posts/the-holy-letter-pei-%D7%A4the-mouth-of-the-universein-hebrew-the-word-peh-%D7%A4%D7%94-means-mo/1402585885207974/)[[5]](https://dinahoverlien.com/2020/07/29/pe/)[[6]](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-pe)

### Forms and Pronunciation

- **Two Sounds:** 
	- With a center dot (called a *dagesh* ), it makes a hard **"P"** sound (as in "pay").
	- Without the dot, it makes a soft **"F"** sound (as in "fun").[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wChdHBw9_s&t=32)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KDDr4JBbZqw&t=127)[[3]](https://dinahoverlien.com/2020/07/29/pe/)
- **Standard and Final Forms:** 
	- **פ** is used at the beginning or in the middle of a word.
	- **ף** (*Sofit* / Final Pe) is used exclusively at the very end of a word and features a descending tail.[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Pey/pey.html)[[2]](https://www.jewishencyclopedia.com/articles/11963-pe)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wChdHBw9_s&t=32)
